sources.entry: CCDash by zihenghe04 - Open-source unified usage dashboard for Claude — track tokens, quota, costs across Claude Code, claude.ai & API in one panel. 开源 Claude 全平台用量监控面板，聚合 Claude Code / claude.ai / API 数据，适用于 Pro/Max 订阅用户与开发者。https://dyp23yngrtumg.ok.kimi.link

summary.one_liner: CCDash is a self-hosted, real-time analytics dashboard that reads local Claude Code JSONL session files to track tokens, costs, sessions and subscription quota, using only Python stdlib.
summary.what_it_does: The dashboard scans ~/.claude/projects JSONL files to show per-call token usage, cost estimated at official API pricing, and per-model and per-project breakdowns. It shows session status (Working, Idle, Done), a session detail timeline with tool calls and file operations, and a session chain for each project. Analytics cover RPM/TPM and burn rate, TTFT and duration, cache efficiency grading, MCP server usage, coding rhythm, and an activity heatmap. Optional config adds 5h and 7d quota tracking via a claude.ai session key, budgets with threshold warnings, and Slack/Discord/HTTP webhook alerts. A lightweight agent.py lets one dashboard aggregate data from remote machines, and ccdash-cli.py offers terminal status views. The README also covers CSV/JSON export, a Git-linked AI cost per commit view, and a Chinese-language version of the docs.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code token usage and cost
estimate API-equivalent cost of a Claude subscription
review past Claude Code sessions and their timelines
aggregate Claude Code usage across multiple servers
get alerts when Claude quota or daily budget is exceeded
how_to_run: Optional: cp config.example.json config.json and edit remotes, budget, webhooks, or session key
Optional: python3 agent.py --port 8421 --token my_secret on a remote host
notable: Reads local Claude Code JSONL files, so no API key is needed and it works with subscription accounts
Zero build step and zero pip/npm dependencies; runs with python3 server.py
Multi-server aggregation via a read-only agent.py with token auth and SSH tunnel support
Session status badges (Working/Idle/Done) that work for local and remote sessions
Bilingual English and Chinese documentation and UI
caveats: Quota tracking needs a claude.ai sessionKey and org ID from browser cookies, and the key expires, so the README says it must be refreshed
macOS-specific parts (launchd auto-start, Swift quota fetcher, autossh tunnel) do not apply to other platforms; Windows fixes are mentioned only as a compatibility change
The README says it is a community project not affiliated with Anthropic
